disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. checked_items.zh: 检查了 OAuth 凭据存储实现（src/store.ts）：插件将 OpenAI Codex OAuth 凭据以 JSON 格式写入 $DSH_HOME/.openai-codex-auth.json，文件权限为 0o600（仅属主可读写），目录权限 0o700，且在读取时校验 POSIX 属主权限（src/store.ts:32-50）。这是合法的凭据管理，非窃取。
checked_items.en: Checked OAuth credential storage implementation (src/store.ts): the plugin writes OpenAI Codex OAuth credentials as JSON to $DSH_HOME/.openai-codex-auth.json with file permission 0o600 (owner read/write only), directory permission 0o700, and validates POSIX owner permission on read (src/store.ts:32-50). This is legitimate credential management, not theft.

checked_items.en: Scanned sensitive path read patterns (.credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws/credentials, etc.): not hit. The plugin only reads its own OAuth file (.openai-codex-auth.json), no unauthorized read of other sensitive paths.

evidence.zh: 凭证外泄无网络闸：插件确实通过 fetch 向 chatgpt.com 发送 OAuth Bearer token（src/transport.ts:291-301、src/search.ts:282-294），但这是 OpenAI Codex 认证协议的必要行为，所有网络端点均为固定的一方常量 URL（chatgpt.com、registry.npmjs.org、api.github.com、raw.githubusercontent.com）。无凭据外泄到第三方域名的行为。
evidence.en: Credential exfiltration without network gate: the plugin does send OAuth Bearer token via fetch to chatgpt.com (src/transport.ts:291-301, src/search.ts:282-294), but this is a necessary behavior of the OpenAI Codex authentication protocol, and all network endpoints are fixed first-party constant URLs (chatgpt.com, registry.npmjs.org, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com). No credential exfiltration to third-party domains.

checked_items.en: Checked tool descriptions (view-image.ts:81 and image-tool.ts:179): the description fields of both registered tools are purely functional descriptions ("View an image from a local file path or an http(s) URL" and "Generate an image from a text prompt..."), containing no system directives, credential reading inducements, unauthorized instructions, or hidden intent.
